name: Nakadashi Oni -Mujintou de Okashiai-
original_name: 中出し鬼－無人島で犯しあい－
source:
It is a habit of our school director to say; "Students! The young people today lack a fighting spirit!"
That said, I didn't expect to have a "Creampie Demon" in the upcoming graduation exam...

The outline of "Creampie Demon" is as follows: Everyone knows the basic rules of the game, the same as "Tag" …But with one difference.

It is...
"A demon (male) must have sex with a caught prey (female) without contraception and with a vaginal cum shot."
"The caught prey must not refuse the demon's sexual activity until the sexual activity is over."

The other party is three childhood friends.
It's kind of familiar and a little distracting, but it's a school graduation exam, so it can't be helped.

Would you like to catch them running away and pour plenty of semen into their wombs?

translation:
我们学校校长的习惯是说；“同学们！现在的年轻人缺乏斗志！”
话说回来，没想到即将到来的毕业考试，竟然出现了“中出恶魔”……

《中出恶魔》的梗概如下：每个人都知道游戏的基本规则，与《Tag》相同……但有一处不同。

这是…
“恶魔（男性）必须在没有避孕的情况下与捕获的猎物（女性）发生性关系，并进行阴道射精。”
“被捕获的猎物在性活动结束之前，不得拒绝恶魔的性活动。”

对方是三个儿时好友。
有点熟悉，又有点分散注意力，但这是学校毕业考试，也没办法。

你想抓住他们逃跑并将大量精液注入他们的子宫吗？
